serviceData.title: Web Development
serviceData.text: Specialized in creating dynamic web solutions using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js). Focused on writing clean, maintainable code and implementing responsive designs with Tailwind CSS and SCSS. My background in visual communication allows me to bridge the gap between complex backend logic and intuitive, high-impact user interfaces.

serviceData.title: Motion Graphics
serviceData.text: Expert in bringing brands to life through dynamic visual storytelling and high-end animation. Leveraging my background in Visual Communication, I specialize in creating engaging motion assets, promotional videos, and UI animations using After Effects and Premiere Pro. I focus on merging timing, typography, and rhythm to deliver compelling narratives that capture audience attention across all digital platforms.

paragraphList.text: Pokémon Finder is a responsive web application built with React and Vite as a final TripleTen bootcamp project. It features real-time data fetching from the PokéAPI with an integrated search history system using LocalStorage for persistence. I utilized Tailwind CSS for a mobile-first design and React Router for seamless single-page navigation. The project demonstrates proficiency in React Hooks for managing asynchronous state and complex API integration. It delivers a high-performance user experience with a polished UI and robust frontend architecture. This application showcases my ability to develop scalable, data-driven web solutions from scratch.

This is a full-stack social gallery application built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js). It features secure JWT authentication, protected routes, and a RESTful API for managing user profiles and interactive image cards. The project highlights end-to-end development skills, including database integration, server-side validation, and a responsive frontend with global state management. It serves as a comprehensive demonstration of building secure, scalable, and data-driven web applications.
